summary.headline: Solid defence, now turn more rallies into attacks
summary.overall_note: You moved well to the back court and kept the shuttle in play. Most lost rallies came from short lifts to the mid-court that let your opponent smash.

video_quality.note: Full court visible from behind the baseline.

rallies.note: Deep clear forced a weak return, you finished at the net.
Short lift was smashed down the line.
Long exchange of clears; end not clearly visible.

moments.label: Great deep clear to the back line
moments.detail: The clear reached the back tramlines and pushed your opponent off balance.

moments.label: Quick net kill
moments.detail: You moved in early and met the shuttle high above the tape.

moments.label: Lift landed mid-court
moments.detail: The lift was short, giving your opponent an easy smash.

moments.label: Recover to base after each shot
moments.detail: You stayed at the front after the drop; get back to the centre.

moments.label: Late split step
moments.detail: You landed after your opponent hit, so the first step was slow.

strengths.title: Deep clears
strengths.explanation: Your clears regularly reach the back of the court, buying time.

weaknesses.title: Short lifts
weaknesses.explanation: Lifts under pressure often land mid-court and get attacked.

weaknesses.title: Recovery to base
weaknesses.explanation: You sometimes stay where you hit instead of returning to the centre.

patterns.title: Opponent targets your backhand corner
patterns.explanation: Several rallies start with a push to your backhand rear court.

takeaways.title: Lift higher and deeper
takeaways.explanation: When under pressure, aim lifts to the back line so you have time to recover.

takeaways.title: Return to base every shot
takeaways.explanation: After each shot, take two steps back to the centre before the opponent hits.

takeaways.title: Split step on their hit
takeaways.explanation: Time a small hop so you land as your opponent strikes the shuttle.

drills.name: Deep lift ladder
drills.how_to: Partner feeds net drops; lift each one to land behind the doubles long service line. 3 sets of 20.

drills.name: Shadow footwork to base
drills.how_to: Shadow 6 corners, touching the centre between each. 5 rounds of 30 seconds.
drills.why: Builds the habit of recovering to base.

limitations: Shuttle is hard to see in some frames, so rally ends are estimated.
